structured.answer: This page says the site doesn't yet calculate or fully explain any of the products it lists, including the ones close to me: structured deposits, dollar-linked and foreign-currency deposits, company bonds, manager's insurance and savings policies. So I won't rely on it for a decision; I'll ask my son or the bank.
